data.body: **[P1] Keep pre-barrier records ahead of the flush.** When an ARN already has a token before a flush barrier, a post-barrier record is appended to the same deque and the sole token is moved behind the barrier. For example, with `a1` in flight, queue `a2`, enqueue a barrier, then schedule `a3`: the queue becomes `[flush, A]`, so the barrier reports success before `a2` is exported. Split pending work by barrier generation or create a separate post-barrier FIFO/token, and add this interleaving to the boundary tests.
